title: fx payload
description: One month of HMRC monthly exchange rates: units of foreign currency per one unit of `base`. Real source, https://www.gov.uk/government/collections/exchange-rates-for-customs-and-vat -- HMRC publishes a file per month at the end of the preceding month and the rates are fixed for that whole month, which is why a period is a fact of the payload and not a free-text note. Reporting currency defaults to USD and the adopters declare GBP (ticket 25); an amount in another currency needs the rate for the price's as_of date, and no rate for that date is a missing instrument that refuses (ADR-0020). The entry map is `rates`.

source.description: The publishing authority this month was read from, verbatim.

period.description: The month these rates are in force for, YYYY-MM. A date outside it has no rate in this version.

base.description: ISO 4217 code every rate is quoted against. HMRC quotes units per GBP.

rates.description: ISO 4217 code -> units of that currency per one unit of `base`. `base` itself is not listed; its rate is 1.
